name: Dobot Lua post-processor
summary: Translates an approved process plan into DobotStudio Pro Lua for the reference Dobot MG400 StruderBot installation.

evidence.label: EXPERIMENTAL
evidence.scope: Deterministic translation validated by tests. The Lua conventions it emits (P()/CalibratedXY, MovL-based J()/L() helpers, single PenOn/PenOff window) match the source project's ROBOT-CONFIRMED conventions, but no program emitted by this exact generator revision has itself been run on physical hardware yet.

guarantees: Refuses to translate a plan without an approval record matching the plan's current revision and authorizing at least executable-export scope.
Emits exactly one PenOn() and one final PenOff() per program, never intermediate extrusion cycling.
Never invents or adjusts geometry; only restates the plan's own points as Lua motion calls.
Reports every untraveled gap between consecutive printed paths as a warning rather than silently choosing how to bridge it.
knownLimitations: Emits only linear (MovL) motion. The operations in this repository currently output sampled point polylines, not native arc/center data, so this post-processor cannot yet emit true Arc3 curves even though the source project's Dobot programming conventions prefer them for production curves. Upgrading this requires the upstream operations to carry arc-native path data, not just a post-processor change.
instanceProfile calibration defaults to an identity/placeholder transform when omitted — see instance-profile.example.json. Never trust default output as calibrated for a real unit.
